Since 0.9.49 it runs on the node declared by .node-version in the task worktree (22, 22.13 or 22.13.0, with an optional leading v and trailing .x; found on the host PATH first, then in the usual install directories, within 15 s in total); a declared node that is not installed, or a .node-version that is there but empty, not a version or unreadable (a directory, no permission, a dangling link), fails the gate with rc 127 instead of running on another node. Only when the worktree has no .node-version entry at all does the command run on the host PATH as before. The result is stored in todos.evidence: testRc, testSummary (names the node), testFailures (up to 8 failed test names), testFailureCount.

buildStallHealMs.description: 0.9.70 (#85): milliseconds without any event before a stuck card is stopped: building -> todo (cancel without discard, worktree and branch kept), reviewing -> merge gate with reviewVerdict none. Doubled while a tool call is open; kept at least one minute above buildStallWarnMs. Default 1800000.

buildStallCooldownMs.description: 0.9.70 (#91): minimum milliseconds between two automatic stops / returns of the stall watchdog, over all cards (in memory; counted from the last automatic stop of this plugin instance). Default 300000.

chiefGateStaleMs.description: #105: milliseconds a card may wait at a gate owned by the Chief (phase review / confirm, gateOwner chief) before one reminder is written on the card timeline and in its topic (no Chief wake, never repeated for the same gate). 0 = off; other values are clamped to 300000-86400000. Default 1200000 (20 minutes).

confirmUnreviewedMerge.description: #103: whether merging a card without a review snapshot (todo.reviewedSha is '') needs the user's confirmation. Default true: merge_build by the Chief is refused, and the user's first todo-action approve_merge is refused with a reason (timeline and lastError) while the second one on the same HEAD merges. false: such a card is merged at once with one timeline line. Cards with reviewedSha are not affected by this switch. Column settings.confirm_unreviewed_merge INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1; existing rows get true.

topicId.description: Optional linked topic ID. #97: it must be a topic of the card's project, same account and profile: an unknown id is refused with 话题不存在：<id>；请改用项目 <name> 的话题或省略 topic_id, a topic of another project with 话题「<title>」属于项目 <Y>，不能创建项目 <Z> 的卡片；请改用项目 <Z> 的话题或省略 topic_id, a topic without a project with 话题「<title>」未归属任何项目，不能创建项目 <Z> 的卡片；…; nothing is stored by a refused call. When omitted or empty only topics of the card's project are candidates, in this order: (1) caller-session: the topic whose Chief session made the call (run.identity.sessionId; the host does not always supply it); (2) caller-tool: the topic whose Chief session started a create-todo tool (tool name matching create_utodo / create_todo) within the last 120 seconds according to the host chat.tool.started events, the latest such call when several did; (3) active-run: the topic whose Chief session has a run under way according to the host chat events, the latest started when several are running, which is then only a guess; (4) chief-topic: the most recently updated non-archived topic of the project that has a Chief session (before #97: of any project); (5) unattended: a non-archived topic of the project without a Chief session, created with Autopilot off when none exists. When the caller found in (1), or for a Chief call guessed in (2) / (3), is a topic of another project or of no project, steps (4) and (5) apply and the card timeline gets 当前话题「<title>」属于项目 <Y> | 未归属任何项目，已转到项目 <X> 的话题「<title>」 (guessed: 建单未指定话题：推断调用方为话题「<title>」，它…). A topic without a project is never chosen. In case (5) a system message starting with 无人值守话题 is stored in that topic and the create_todo tool answers data.topicResolvedBy = unattended. In case (3) with several Chief sessions of the project running the create_todo tool says so in content: pass topic_id explicitly.

items.description: Topic record. #97: projectId of a topic stored without a project that holds cards is set once, on the first snapshot or Chief use after the upgrade, to the project most of its cards belong to (see CONTRACTS.md, Topic / project ownership). topicScopeReason, read-only and derived on every read (never stored, not an input), is present only when the topic has no project or holds cards of other projects: { code: 'no-project' | 'foreign-todos', message: string (Chinese sentence the page can show as it is), projectId: string (the topic's project, '' for no-project), todoCount: integer (cards in the topic), foreignTodoCount: integer (cards in it that are not of its project; equals todoCount for no-project), suggestedProjectId?: string (only for foreign-todos when every card in the topic is of one and the same other existing project: the project the topic should probably be moved to with update-topic; nothing is changed automatically) }. Absent on every other topic.

Todo record. Since 0.9.68 a card the size budget reduced to a stub carries stubbed: true and stubbedFields (names of the detail fields that had content: spec, plan, diffs, buildChat, timeline, evidence, question, fallbackHistory); it keeps id, number, title, kind, phase, gateOwner, gateKind, projectId, topicId, agentId, reviewerId, engine, withPlan, tags, lastError, revision, createdAt, updatedAt, branch, worktreePath, snapshotSha, buildSessionId, reviewSessionId, an evidence object reduced to its numbers, booleans and strings of at most 120 characters, an active question, diffCount (number of diff files) and hasPlan; spec and plan are empty strings and diffs, buildChat, timeline, fallbackHistory empty arrays. get-todo-detail loads the details. Absent on a card that was not reduced. #97: topicProjectMismatch, read-only and derived on every read (never stored, not accepted as input), is present only on a card whose topic is not a topic of its project: { todoProjectId: string (the card's project), topicProjectId: string (the project of its topic, '' when the topic has no project or no longer exists), topicId: string (todos.topic_id as stored, may be ''), topicExists: boolean, repairable: boolean (false while phase is building, reviewing or merging), reason: string ('' when repairable, else 任务正在执行（构建 / 审查 / 合并中），先等当前轮结束或停止后再修) }. Absent on every other card; a stub keeps it and get-todo-detail returns it too. Such a card wakes no Chief and no Chief tool acts on it from the wrong topic; repair-todo-topic moves it. Since #103 every todo (stub included) carries reviewedSha (string, column todos.reviewed_sha TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''): the full 40-character sha of the worktree HEAD the current independent review was dispatched on, '' when the card has no review snapshot (never reviewed, reviewed before #103, or a build was dispatched since: every build dispatch clears it with the verdict). The merge takes a card with reviewedSha only when the worktree HEAD and the branch tip still equal it and git status --porcelain is empty. evidence gains reviewDrift (string, default '', at most 600 characters: why the worktree is no longer the reviewed commit, written when a review settles or a merge is refused, cleared by every review and build dispatch) and unreviewedMergeAsk (string, default '': the full HEAD sha the user was asked to confirm a merge without review snapshot for; cleared by every review and build dispatch).

hostMaxTurns.description: agent.max_turns read from $HERMES_HOME (default ~/.hermes) config.yaml, profile config first; bare or quoted integers; 0 when absent or 0. Informational only.

hostTurnBudget.description: Turn cap the host really applies to plugin sessions (since 0.9.70, #84). effective = HERMES_BRIDGE_MAX_TURNS when > 0, else a positive config.yaml agent.max_turns, else the Web UI bridge default 90.

configured.description: Raw config.yaml agent.max_turns ($HERMES_HOME first, quoted integers accepted); omitted when the key is absent or not an integer.

snapshotTrimmed.description: Present and true only when this snapshot was trimmed to stay under the 1,500,000-byte budget (host limit 2,000,000). Storage is never trimmed. Omitted when the full state fits.

snapshotOverflow.description: Present and true only when the board was still above the host's 2,000,000-byte limit after every trimming stage. The snapshot is then a degraded one: settings, concurrency and counts are real, memories is an empty array, uploaded avatars are replaced by stand-ins, agents and projects stay listed (reduced to stubs with stub=true when they are what is too large: agents keep id, name, role; projects keep id, name, monogram, accent), and every topic and todo is a stub marked stub=true that only names it (topics: id, title, archived, updatedAt; todos: id, number, title, phase, gateOwner, gateKind, updatedAt, projectId, topicId) with empty collections for everything else. Stored data is untouched. Omitted otherwise.

overflowBytes.description: Only with snapshotOverflow: size in bytes of the fully trimmed board that could not be returned.

topicsOmitted.description: Number of whole topics left out of this snapshot as the final trimming stage: archived topics first, then the least recently active; the most recently active topic always stays. In a snapshotOverflow snapshot it counts topic stubs that did not fit. Omitted when no topic was left out. Stored topics are never deleted by trimming.

memoriesOmitted.description: Number of memories left out of this snapshot when it was over the size budget; the 100 kept are pinned ones first, then the most recently updated. Omitted when no memory was left out. Stored memories are never deleted by trimming.

todosOmitted.description: Number of todo cards left out of this snapshot. Since 0.9.68 finished (done/closed) and then idle (todo/queued/failed) cards are first reduced to stubs (todos[].stubbed: true; the board lists them and the drawer loads their details with get-todo-detail), and cards are left out only when even the stubs do not fit: oldest first, finished, then idle, and as a last resort confirm and then review cards. Cards that are building, reviewing or merging are never left out or stubbed. The board shows the number under the 已完成 column (还有 N 张卡未加载). In a snapshotOverflow snapshot it counts card stubs that did not fit. Omitted when no card was left out; counts.total and counts.done still describe the full board.

topicContextOutput.description: 0.9.43: what the page needs to show the Chief context capsule and to decide whether slash commands can be sent. Read-only; tokens in use are not part of it (they arrive on the live session as resumed.contextTokens / usage.updated.contextTokens / /context results).

sessionId.description: Chief host session ID; empty when the topic has no Chief session yet.

compressionThreshold.description: Share of the context window at which the host compresses automatically (host config compression.threshold, read through GET /api/hermes/config?section=compression). A section without a usable value is 0.5, as the host reads it; clamped to 0.05–0.95. 0.65 when the host config could not be read.

thresholdSource.description: host = compressionThreshold comes from the host config; fallback = the host did not answer within 3 s and 0.65 is used.

compressingSince.description: Unix ms when the current manual compression lock was taken; 0 when none.

beginTopicCompressOutput.description: 0.9.43: the compression lock was taken. Until it ends (record-topic-command with command compress, or until passes) no Chief turn starts for the topic; sends and wakes are queued.

ok.description: Always true; refusals are thrown with a Chinese reason.

since.description: Unix ms the lock was taken.

until.description: Unix ms the lock expires by itself (since + 135000) if the page never reports the outcome.

lockId.description: Random id of this lock (16 hex characters). Only a record-topic-command carrying it releases the lock.

recordTopicCommandInput.description: 0.9.43: outcome of a slash command the page sent over the live Chief session; written into the topic as a system message. A compress/compact outcome with the matching lockId also releases the compression lock. Not called when the page lost the session before the answer (outcome unknown).

command.description: Canonical command name without the slash, e.g. compress, status, context.

outcome.description: completed / failed / timeout (no terminal event within the page's limit, 120 s for compress) / unsupported (the host did not dispatch the command). Defaults from ok when omitted.

message.description: Host message of the session.command event (or the page's reason); stored at most 2000 characters.

beforeTokens.description: Compress only: context tokens before, from the host event.

afterTokens.description: Compress only: context tokens after, from the host event.

compressed.description: Compress only: the host's compressed flag; false means the host found nothing to fold and left the history unchanged. Omitted when the host did not say.

lockId.description: Compress only: the lockId begin-topic-compress returned. The lock is released only when it matches the current lock; omitted (probe failed before any lock) or different (stale tab, late answer) leaves the lock in place. The system message is written either way.

settleResult.description: Summary of one pass of the settle action, which copies the last messages of Chief turns that just ended into their topics.

ok.description: Success indicator. Always true; a failed host read is retried on a later pass.

pending.description: Topics still waiting for another pass after this one. 0 when nothing is waiting.

repair-topic-todos.description: #97. Batch form of repair-todo-topic for one topic: every card with todos.topic_id = topicId whose project is not the topic's project (all of its cards when the topic has no project) is moved to a non-archived topic of its own project, chosen as in repair-todo-topic (Chief topic updated last, else one without a Chief session, else a new topic titled with the project name, autopilot false; one target per project). Per moved card: todos.topic_id (revision + 1), watches from topics that do not own its project ended, a watch from the new topic unless it is done or closed, and the timeline line 归属修复：从话题「<old>」（…）转到项目 <name> 的话题「<new>」. Topic messages: one system message starting with 归属修复：本话题有 <N> 张 in the topic and one starting with 归属修复：<N> 张卡片 in each target topic (not one per card). Cards in phase building, reviewing or merging and cards whose project no longer exists are not moved and are listed in skipped with the reason. dryRun: true stores nothing and answers the same lists (newTopicId and topics[].id are '' for a topic that would be created). Idempotent: a second call moves nothing more (moved and topics empty; cards still in flight stay in skipped). Nothing else is written: messages, sessions, branches, worktrees, diffs, evidence and phases stay. A topic stored without a project that was never adopted is adopted first by a run (project of most of its cards, as on first load), and dryRun judges it as if it had been, storing nothing, so only the cards that are not of the adopted project are moved; a topic the user detached is not adopted and all its cards are moved. A project that was set is never changed by this call. Throws 话题不存在：<id> for an unknown topic.

repair-todo-topic.description: #97. Repair one card whose topic is not a topic of its project (a card stored before the ownership rule, a topic later moved to another project, detached from its project, or deleted). Picks a non-archived topic of the card's project: the most recently updated one with a Chief session, else one without, else a new topic titled with the first 32 characters of the card title, autopilot false. Writes todos.topic_id (revision + 1), ends the card's active watches from topics that are not of its project, adds a watch from the new topic unless the card is done or closed, appends the timeline line 归属修复：从话题「<old>」（属于项目 <name> | 未归属任何项目）转到项目 <name> 的话题「<new>」, and stores one system message starting with 归属修复：#<number> in the old topic (when it still exists) and one in the new topic. Nothing else is written or removed: topic messages, build and review sessions, branch, worktree, diffs, evidence and phase stay. Idempotent: a card that is in a topic of its project is returned unchanged and nothing is written. Throws Todo not found for an unknown id or another user/profile, #<number> 任务正在执行（构建 / 审查 / 合并中），先等当前轮结束或停止后再修 while phase is building, reviewing or merging, and #<number> 所属项目 <id> 已不存在，无法修复话题归属 when the project was removed. Only this call moves a card; there is no automatic or batch migration.

retry-merge.description: Since 0.9.48. Put a todo whose merge failed back at the merge gate: phase failed -> review (state event RETRY_MERGE), lastError cleared, gateKind merge (deploy for a deploy card), gateOwner recomputed from the settings as they are now (human for a deploy card, a topic without AUTO, a project without autoMergeAfterReview, a configured test gate whose evidence.testRc is not 0, a non-empty evidence.gateSkipped or an open question; chief otherwise). evidence, branch, worktreePath, snapshotSha and diffs are not written. Only for a card in phase failed with gateKind failed whose lastError starts with 合并失败, with a branch and a worktree directory that exists; otherwise it throws, writes the reason on the card timeline and changes nothing else. A missing worktree is never recreated. Does not merge: todo-action approve_merge / merge_build runs every check again. Refused while another write on the same card is running.

todo-action.description: Run a todo lifecycle transition including continue/fresh retries, plan confirm, review, and merge. Since #104 complete is checked on the server like the tool complete_todo: it is rejected with a Chinese reason, and nothing is written, while the card waits for the user's answer or plan approval, and for a code card (kind feature, bug or deploy with a branch or snapshot) in phase review whose worktree has uncommitted entries or whose snapshot, branch tip or worktree HEAD is not an ancestor of the default branch (#N 有未合并改动，请走合并或先取消); question and content cards, and cards in todo or failed, are not checked. An accepted complete writes 标记完成 with actor user. complete, close, a proven merge and a cancel_build that puts the card back to todo end every active watch of the card (todo_watches.active = 0); a done or closed card that is dispatched again or reopened first ends the watches it still has. Since #103 approve_merge checks the review binding as the first step of the merge (see the tool merge_build): a card whose branch is not todo.reviewedSha, or has uncommitted changes, goes back to the merge gate with the reason on lastError and the timeline; a card without reviewedSha is refused once with 再点一次合并即确认 and merged by the second approve_merge on the same HEAD (setting confirmUnreviewedMerge, default true). Since 0.9.49 cancel_build, close and reopen take the per-card write lock like the other actions (a second write on the same card is refused, not queued), and close is refused with 任务正在合并，完成后再操作 while the card is merging. Also since 0.9.49: cancel_build on a card that is done or closed is refused with a Chinese reason and changes nothing (it used to write the card back to todo), close on a done card is refused with a Chinese reason instead of the state machine error, and review writes the card as reviewing before the review run is launched (a launch that fails puts the card back). Instructions to the worker (message_todo, request_changes, answer_question, confirm_plan) answer within about 1500 ms: the same instruction inside 60 s is not dispatched again, one to a busy worker session waits in todo_queue until its turn ends, one refused by the host as already running fails with a readable lastError, and one sent while the card is still starting is refused with a reason. Since Todo #107 an instruction is never dropped by a full build queue: it is stored in todo_queue with the card (phase queued) and sent with the task prompt when the card is started, and message_todo / request_changes to a card that is not building are sent as a follow-up prompt (instruction + report of the round before + task prompt). Since #109 approve_merge never commits uncommitted changes of a card that has a snapshot or a reviewed commit: they refuse the merge (file names in the reason), see the tool merge_build and docs/CONTRACTS.md, Merge atomicity.

list_todos.description: List todos, optionally filtered by project_id, topic_id or phase. #97: called by a Chief session (identified by run.identity.sessionId, else by the open tool calls and running Chief sessions) it lists the cards of the calling topic's own project only; a project_id or topic_id of another project, all_projects: true, and a call from a topic without a project answer ok: false, error: TOPIC_PROJECT_MISMATCH with the reason and the topic to use (never an empty list); when Chief sessions of different projects may be calling and cannot be told apart it answers ok: false, error: CALLER_AMBIGUOUS until the call carries caller_topic_id (optional string: the calling Chief's own topic id). Since #108 the value is accepted only when that topic is one of the candidates of the call and its Chief session has this tool open under its own tool name (openToolCalls; a tool_call wrapper hides which tool is called and is no evidence, so a value given by a Chief that calls through a wrapper is refused too); any other value, a value given while the candidates are known from running Chiefs only, and a value given when there is no candidate are refused with CALLER_AMBIGUOUS. A refusal for a topic without a project starts with 本话题未归属项目，请先改挂项目 and carries data.topicScopeReason; an empty list for a Chief says 本话题所属项目（<id>）下暂无匹配的任务；本话题只列出该项目的卡片。 and data.projectId, and data.topicScopeReason when the topic holds cards of other projects. all_projects (boolean, default false) is the cross-project overview for callers that are not a Chief session: it lists every project and ignores project_id.

create_todo.description: Create a backlog todo. data.topicId is the topic the card was linked to and data.topicResolvedBy how it was chosen: explicit (topic_id given), caller-session, caller-tool (since 0.9.45: the Chief session that has just started this tool), active-run, chief-topic or unattended. active-run with several Chief sessions running is a guess (the latest started run): content then says 当前有 N 个总管会话在运行，无法确定建卡归属，请显式传 topic_id. unattended means no caller topic and no Chief topic was found: the card sits in a topic without a Chief session, its progress wakes nobody, content says so, and the caller should pass topic_id explicitly. #97: the card is only linked to a topic of its own project. A topic_id of another project or of no project is refused. When the calling topic is of another project (or of none) the card goes to a topic of its project: data.topicRedirectedFrom is then the calling topic id and content says 当前话题「<title>」不属于该项目，卡片已转到该项目的话题 <topicId>; that topic gets its progress, the calling topic does not.

update_todo.description: Update an existing todo. #97: called by a Chief session, the card must belong to the project of the calling topic (own project only); otherwise nothing is done and the tool answers ok: false, error: TOPIC_PROJECT_MISMATCH with the topic to use. Callers that are not a Chief session are not restricted. When the call carries no session identity and several sessions may be making it, it is let through only if every Chief that may be calling owns the card's project; otherwise it answers ok: false, error: CALLER_AMBIGUOUS (无法确定调用方话题，请显式传 topic_id…) and nothing is done, until the Chief repeats it with caller_topic_id (optional string, the id of its own topic). Since #108 the value is accepted only when that topic is one of the candidates of the call and its Chief session has this tool open under its own tool name (openToolCalls; a tool_call wrapper hides which tool is called and is no evidence, so a value given by a Chief that calls through a wrapper is refused too); any other value, a value given while the candidates are known from running Chiefs only, and a value given when there is no candidate keep or cause the CALLER_AMBIGUOUS refusal.

run_review.description: Dispatch a cross-engine independent read-only review. Since #103 the dispatch first commits what the worktree holds uncommitted (git add -A + commit, as the merge did before) and writes todo.reviewedSha = the full sha of the worktree HEAD; when the review settles with the worktree no longer on that commit (HEAD moved or uncommitted changes), evidence.reviewDrift says why, the timeline gets a warning and the card is handed to the user: the verdict cannot be merged on. Since #103 only VERDICT: APPROVED alone on the last line approves (see docs/CONTRACTS.md, Review integrity): a verdict in a sentence, in quotes, in code, followed by a condition, or the bare word APPROVED is inconclusive; VERDICT: NOT APPROVED, 不通过, 驳回, 需修改, 需要修改 and 不可合并 on that line reject like CHANGES_REQUESTED. The result is written to todo.evidence.reviewVerdict when the review turn ends: approved, changes_requested (read from the last VERDICT: APPROVED / VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED line of the reviewer's last message, ASCII or full-width colon; since 0.9.52 the rejection line may also be written VERDICT: CHANGES REQUESTED or VERDICT: CHANGES-REQUESTED), and since 0.9.49 inconclusive (the turn ended without a VERDICT line, its last VERDICT line names both verdicts, or it ends with VERDICT: APPROVED while a VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED line is also in the message; the reviewer is first asked once for it in the same session, evidence.reviewInconclusiveRetries counts that request and is reset to 0 by every review and build dispatch) or review_failed (the review run failed). inconclusive and review_failed park the card at phase review with gateOwner human and gateKind review_inconclusive / review_failed; they are not a rejection, no rework is due and the Chief is not run for them: call run_review again or leave the decision to the user. #97: called by a Chief session, the card must belong to the project of the calling topic (own project only); otherwise nothing is done and the tool answers ok: false, error: TOPIC_PROJECT_MISMATCH with the topic to use. Callers that are not a Chief session are not restricted. message_todo.description: Send follow-up context to a todo worker. Waits for the host to accept the worker run for at most 1500 ms; after that it answers with data.accepted=true and data.starting=true while the launch continues, and the outcome is written to the card timeline. data.queued=true: the worker session was busy and the message waits in todo_queue until its turn ends (no run sent). data.duplicate=true: the same message was accepted less than 60 s ago and was not sent again. Since Todo #107: a message to a card that is not building (review, failed, todo, confirm) starts a new round whose prompt holds three parts, the message under the heading 本轮追加要求（必须逐条完成）, the report of the round before and the full task prompt; a card that is building gets the bare message in its session. data.parked=true: every build slot was taken, the card went to phase queued, no run was sent and the message is stored in todo_queue; it goes out with the task prompt when the card is started (it used to be dropped). An empty message and one longer than 20000 characters are refused with an error and a timeline line (补充指令没有发出), nothing is sent or cut; a message longer than 12000 characters that would have to wait in todo_queue is refused the same way (没有送达). An accepted launch writes the timeline line 本轮由 message_todo 触发，追加要求 N 字 with the first 300 characters of the message. #97: called by a Chief session, the card must belong to the project of the calling topic (own project only); otherwise nothing is done and the tool answers ok: false, error: TOPIC_PROJECT_MISMATCH with the topic to use. Callers that are not a Chief session are not restricted. When the call carries no session identity and several sessions may be making it, it is let through only if every Chief that may be calling owns the card's project; otherwise it answers ok: false, error: CALLER_AMBIGUOUS (无法确定调用方话题，请显式传 topic_id…) and nothing is done, until the Chief repeats it with caller_topic_id (optional string, the id of its own topic). Since #108 the value is accepted only when that topic is one of the candidates of the call and its Chief session has this tool open under its own tool name (openToolCalls; a tool_call wrapper hides which tool is called and is no evidence, so a value given by a Chief that calls through a wrapper is refused too); any other value, a value given while the candidates are known from running Chiefs only, and a value given when there is no candidate keep or cause the CALLER_AMBIGUOUS refusal.

merge_build.description: Merge a todo parked at the review gate into the project base branch. Refused unless topic AUTO, project autoMergeAfterReview, an APPROVED review of the current build, a passing test gate, and no deploy redline. Since #103 also refused (for the Chief and the user alike, card back at the merge gate with gateOwner human, reason on lastError and the timeline) when the branch is not the commit that was reviewed: the worktree HEAD or the branch tip differs from todo.reviewedSha (both full shas are in the text), or git status --porcelain is not empty; run_review again to bind the new HEAD. A card without reviewedSha is refused for the Chief while the setting confirmUnreviewedMerge is on (default); the user confirms it on the board. This check runs before, and independently of, the merge proof of #102. Since Todo #102 the merge is proven: before it, the worktree must exist with HEAD on the card's branch and equal to (or containing) the card's snapshotSha; after it, that commit must be an ancestor of the base branch. A failed proof leaves the card failed (lastError starts with 合并失败（merge_verify_failed), keeps the worktree and the branch, and is answered ok: false. The answer follows the returned card: 'Merged #n (...) and marked done.' with data.commitSha, data.merged: true and data.mergeKind (merge_commit, fast_forward, already_merged) only for a done card with evidence.mergeVerify: passed; a card still in merging or taken over by another write is reported as not marked done (data.merged: false, data.commitSha: ''). #97: called by a Chief session, the card must belong to the project of the calling topic (own project only); otherwise nothing is done and the tool answers ok: false, error: TOPIC_PROJECT_MISMATCH with the topic to use. Callers that are not a Chief session are not restricted. When the call carries no session identity and several sessions may be making it, it is let through only if every Chief that may be calling owns the card's project; otherwise it answers ok: false, error: CALLER_AMBIGUOUS (无法确定调用方话题，请显式传 topic_id…) and nothing is done, until the Chief repeats it with caller_topic_id (optional string, the id of its own topic). Since #108 the value is accepted only when that topic is one of the candidates of the call and its Chief session has this tool open under its own tool name (openToolCalls; a tool_call wrapper hides which tool is called and is no evidence, so a value given by a Chief that calls through a wrapper is refused too); any other value, a value given while the candidates are known from running Chiefs only, and a value given when there is no candidate keep or cause the CALLER_AMBIGUOUS refusal. Since #109 the reviewed commit is handed to the merge as its expected HEAD (for a card without reviewedSha: the HEAD that was confirmed), and the merge never commits what a card with a snapshot or a reviewed commit holds uncommitted: a worktree that changed after the check fails the merge with merge_verify_failed (工作树在审查/快照之后有 N 项未提交改动, the first 5 paths listed, or 不是期望合并的提交 with both shas; worktree and branch kept, retry_merge applies), and a card without reviewedSha that has a snapshot and uncommitted changes is refused at the gate (请先提交或清理再合并, or run_review, which commits them). Only a card with neither reviewedSha nor snapshotSha still has uncommitted files committed by the merge, with the timeline line 为无审查快照的卡自动提交了 N 个文件. See docs/CONTRACTS.md, Merge atomicity.

retry_merge.description: Since 0.9.48. Put a todo whose merge failed back at the merge gate, keeping its review verdict, branch and worktree. Only for a card that stopped in failed because its merge failed (lastError starts with 合并失败); a build failure or an idle round is refused (ok=false, error RETRY_MERGE_REFUSED). Does not merge: call merge_build afterwards, which checks everything again (since #103 including that the branch still is todo.reviewedSha: a conflict resolved by a new commit needs run_review first). Input todo_id. data: id, phase, gateOwner, reviewVerdict. #97: called by a Chief session, the card must belong to the project of the calling topic (own project only); otherwise nothing is done and the tool answers ok: false, error: TOPIC_PROJECT_MISMATCH with the topic to use. cancel_build.description: Stop an active build/review session (discard: also remove the worktree and branch). Since 0.9.49 it takes the per-card write lock (refused while another write runs on the card) and is refused with 任务正在合并，完成后再操作 while a merge runs on the card, or with discard on any card in phase merging. A card in phase done or closed is refused too (nothing runs on it), with or without discard, and is not changed. #97: called by a Chief session, the card must belong to the project of the calling topic (own project only); otherwise nothing is done and the tool answers ok: false, error: TOPIC_PROJECT_MISMATCH with the topic to use. complete_todo.description: Mark a todo as done. #104: refused, with nothing written, as ok: false, error: COMPLETE_REFUSED and a Chinese reason in content when (a) the card waits for the user's answer or plan approval, or (b) it is a code card (kind feature, bug or deploy with a branch or snapshot) at a gate (phase review) whose work is not all in the default branch: uncommitted entries in the worktree, or the snapshot, branch tip or worktree HEAD not an ancestor of the default branch (#N 有未合并改动，请走合并或先取消). Use merge_build, or cancel the card first. question and content cards are not checked. An accepted call writes the timeline entry 总管标记完成 with actor chief and ends every watch of the card. #97: called by a Chief session, the card must belong to the project of the calling topic (own project only); otherwise nothing is done and the tool answers ok: false, error: TOPIC_PROJECT_MISMATCH with the topic to use. reconcile.description: Reconcile active Chief, build, and review sessions and trigger idempotent wakes. Since 0.9.49 a review turn found finished without a VERDICT line is not settled as a rejection: the reviewer is asked once for the verdict in the same session, then the card parks at a human gate (gateKind review_inconclusive).

settle.description: Follow-up syncs after a Chief turn ends: first pass about 1s after the turn was seen finished, then up to 3 retries about 2s apart, until a pass adds nothing and the host message tail stopped changing. Repeatable without duplicates (one row per host message id). A successful pass clears the topic's isRunning and activeRunId unless a new turn has started.
